immutable_failure_reproduction.failed_job: Deploy dev under shared environment lease
immutable_failure_reproduction.observed_failure: HTTP 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR returned immediately during persona create-paper-bundle bootstrap
immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: Two unhandled runtime exceptions inside BFF persona creation handlers caused FastAPI to return a generic HTTP 500: (1) NameError: name 'build_persona_runtime_profile' is not defined inside _openclaw_agent_reconcile_request because build_persona_runtime_profile was not imported at module level in main.py; (2) _persona_record_for_provisioning attempted to call write/mutation methods on read_store facade rather than routing mutations through the durable Persona provisioning/write owner and reading from the store. In addition, unhandled exceptions inside bff_create_persona were not mapped to a typed 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR envelope with sanitized diagnostics.

resolution_summary.runtime_profile_import: Added top-level import of build_persona_runtime_profile and PersonaRuntimeProfile in services/control-plane/bff/main.py with robust fallbacks, sanitized blocked_reason, and defensive exception handling in _openclaw_agent_reconcile_request.
resolution_summary.read_ports_read_only_boundary: Ensured ReadSurfacePorts, PersonaCapitalRuntimeDomainPort, and PersonaFleetPort remain strictly read-only facades with no mutation methods or internal in-memory write stores; routed mutations strictly through durable PersonaProvisioningStore and PersonaProvisioningCoordinator saga.
resolution_summary.sanitized_diagnostics_envelope: Wrapped bff_create_persona coordinator invocation and downstream rejection handling with structured 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR error mapping, surfacing stable sanitized diagnostic reasons, precondition_failed, and suggestions without leaking str(exc), terminalReason, idempotencyKey, runtime profile text, or secrets.
resolution_summary.restart_readback_persistence: Added durable store fallback in bff_get_persona and restart recovery ensuring persona readback and idempotent retries succeed even when in-memory overlay caches are cleared.
resolution_summary.compose_contract_fix: Updated docker-compose.yml operator-bff PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL to use canonical environment fallback ${PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL:-http://registry:8087} matching compose contract.
resolution_summary.deterministic_tests: Added comprehensive test suite services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_persona_provisioning_baseline_500.py covering reproduction imports and read-only ports contract, clean dev paper baseline creation, idempotent retries, idempotency conflicts, typed 502 downstream error diagnostics with error sanitization, RBAC gates, durable owner delegation, and restart readback consistency.

fail_closed_boundaries: Unauthenticated requests are rejected with HTTP 401.
Non-operator roles (e.g. viewer) are rejected with HTTP 403.
Non-paper capital modes and non-low risk levels are rejected with HTTP 422.
Idempotency key reused with different request payload is rejected with HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Downstream coordinator or owner failures fail closed and return typed HTTP 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR with structured sanitized diagnostics, never generic 500.
Failure preserves compensation to exact accepted read-only FE/BFF baseline with all writes false.

release_closeout_gate.required_backend: the Pantheon dev merge containing this manifest and the independently approved head
